where: crates/blaze-launch-host/src/tests.rs (the model launcher of the DST)
what: The simulation's model launcher checked that a record names only declared slots with `slot < declared.max(u32::MAX)`, which is true of every slot. An edit that declared its slots before its records' references had assigned them passed the DST and failed the first real run (`names slot 8, and 8 are declared`).
cost: a bug the DST exists to catch reached a real program; found only because the measurement checks output
cause: an oracle condition I wrote to be permissive while the declaration rule was unsettled, and never tightened
whys: why wrong: the oracle's bound could not fail
why possible: the model re-derived nothing from the records it was sent (it did not keep their bytes)
why not caught: no planted bug exercised that condition, so nothing showed it was vacuous
why easy: a control was written for each bug I thought of, not for each condition of the oracle
property: an oracle condition with no control that makes it fail
class: vacuous oracle condition: a check inside a simulation's oracle that no planted bug can trip
prevention: every condition of a DST oracle has a planted-bug control that fails on exactly it (the invariants gate, scripts/src/bin/invariants.rs, lists conditions without a control); done here for this one (`the_oracle_catches_an_edit_that_declares_before_its_records_name`)
workaround: the model keeps the records' bytes and checks each function place against the declared count
state: fixed for this condition (5226c3d363); the gate's check is open
